result.topic_en: Draft definition of the p-fold Riemann theta series as a sum over integers of the exponential of a quadratic form plus linear terms, with the convergence condition (negative real part of the quadratic form) and the quasi-periodicity relations under v_mu -> v_mu + pi i and v_mu -> v_mu + a_{mu,mu'}.

methods.what: Definition of the p-variable theta function as a p-fold sum over integers of exp of a quadratic form plus linear term
methods.quote: $\vartheta(v_1, v_2, \dots v_p) = \left(\sum_{-\infty}^{\infty}\right)^p e^{\left(\sum_1^p\right)^2 a_{\mu,\mu'} m_\mu m_{\mu'} + 2\sum_1^p v_\mu m_\mu}$

methods.what: Convergence condition: real part of the quadratic form must be negative definite
methods.quote:
Damit die Reihe convergirt, muß der reelle Theil von $\left(\sum_1^p\right)^2 a_{\mu,\mu'} m_\mu m_{\mu'}$ [-...-] wesentlich nega-
tiv sein.

methods.what: Periodicity of theta under shift by pi i
Quasi-periodicity of theta under shift by a column of the period matrix
methods.quote: $\vartheta(v_1 + a_{1,\mu}, v_2 + a_{2,\mu}, \dots v_p + a_{p,\mu}) = e^{-2v_\mu - a_{\mu,\mu}}\vartheta$

items.quote: Diese Function hat die Eigenschaft, daß bei gleichzeitiger Änderung von $v_1, v_2, \dots v_p$ um $a_{1,\mu}, a_{2,\mu}$
items.english: This function has the property that under simultaneous change of v_1, v_2, ..., v_p by a_{1,mu}, a_{2,mu}, ... (log theta changes only by an additive term).
